THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Reference No.: 4/1/1/32-Q. Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4-3/7/2020/HW/158. I do hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose : Description of the land to be acquired:

Twenty four (24) allotments of Land from Lot 01 to 24 in Extent of 0.4946 Hectare of land, depicted in Cadastral Map No. 420376 Block No. 01 Sheet No. 01, Dated 21st June, 2023 prepared by the Senior Superintendent of the Surveys, Kurunegala District on behalf of the Surveyor General, situated in the villages of Theliyagonne and Ambalampitiya in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 808, Weherabenda and No. 836 Theliyagonna of the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kurunegala in the District of Kurunegala, in the North Western Province.

No. of the Divisional Secretariat: CHI/LND/1/AC/5/74. Ref. No. of the Ministry of Tourism & Lands.: 4-3/18/2019/WS/579. I hereby give notice under Sub-Section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for the Laying of Pipe Lines and for the construction of Valve Chamber of Chilaw Water Supply Scheme. Description of the land to be acquired:
All that allotment of land depicted in sheet No. 1, block No. 04, Cadastral map No. 410329, prepared by the

Superintendent of Surveys, Puttalam, situated at the Village of Munneshewarama, in Munneshwarama Grama Niladhari Division, No. 568, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Chillaw in Puttalam District North Western Province and bounded as follows: 01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Muththankudi Irunda Chekku Adithottam; Description: Open bare land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Rajaputhrage Thilini Dineshika, Behind the Old Water Tank, Near the lake, Deduru Oya, Chillaw; Extent: 0.0367 Hectare. All persons who claim ownership, interest or any other connection to the aforesaid land hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me on 06.05.2024 at 10.00 a.m. At the Divisional Secretariat, Chillaw. And further, you are hereby requested to notify to me in writing in duplicate before 22.04.2024 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. B. W. M. M. S. Bandara, Divisional Secretary, Chillaw. At the Divisional Secretariat, Chillaw 7th March 2024. EOG 03-0124
